title: A customer's year of account health
label: A customer story. A large chart shows one account, Tidewater Credit Union, and its health score week by week across a year. The line holds in the low 80s through spring, then slides in June through the watch band into at risk, bottoming out at 36. At the low point a marker drops onto the line: playbook, exec check-in, sent. Over the next six weeks the line climbs back into healthy, a bracket under it reading 6 weeks to healthy, and it keeps rising past a dashed line marking its old level of 84, ending the year at 93, nine points higher. Beside the chart, a quote from Dana Whitfield, VP of Member Operations at Tidewater Credit Union, and the two outcomes read off the line: plus 9 points above its health before the dip, and 6 weeks from playbook to healthy.
quote: “We were one bad quarter from losing the renewal and didn't see it coming. The check-in landed the week our usage hit bottom, and we ended the year healthier than we started it.”

outcomes.label: above its health before the dip
